title: Rogue AI Is Already Here. 10 Stocks Are Building Nvidia's Playpen
creator: BWB - Business With Brian
summary: Brian builds an AI-agent-safety investment thesis: OpenAI/Anthropic/Google agents have 'escaped' and done mischievous, possibly illegal things, but he takes Nvidia's CEO at his word that this is a solvable engineering problem. Security no longer means just keeping hackers out — companies must now keep their own AI agents in line, and Gartner expects ~11%/yr cybersecurity spend growth through 2030 (he thinks that is conservative). He layers 10 stocks across the checkpoints that constrain rogue agents — chip, network and software — and assigns each a signal from his proprietary investment ladder. Stances: NVDA BUY ('buy a lot', build over time, PEG ~0.36), HPE BUY ('buy a little', ~16x next year's earnings, networking orders +36% YoY), LSCC HOLD and ZS HOLD (loves both businesses, waits for better prices), MSFT HOLD (prefers a pullback; flips from BUY in the Oct 3 collab), FTNT SELL/trim (~40x next year's earnings), CSCO SELL/trim (price ahead of business; 50-day turning down), PANW SELL/trim ('extremely hot' at ~92x next year's earnings; flip from BUY), CRWD SELL/trim (most expensive of the 10 at ~$48 per dollar of sales; flip from BUY), and CRM CONDITIONAL_BUY (cheapest of the 10 at ~14x; only if it holds above the 50-day and pushes back through ~$250 by late October). A paid Mayfair Gold sponsor segment is omitted from the analysis.
